action.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN days_past_due <= 0 THEN 'current' WHEN days_past_due <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN days_past_due <= 60 THEN '31-60' ELSE '61+' END AS bucket, SUM(outstanding) AS outstanding_amount FROM (SELECT amount - amount_paid AS outstanding, DATE '2026-06-30' - due_date AS days_past_due FROM ar_invoices WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND amount - amount_paid > 0) t GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY MIN(days_past_due)
